homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field; its negative tags ('NOT IPTC embedded metadata'; no judgement of truth; no identity) disambiguate the object, not the name. 'C2PA Conformance Tool' (the C2PA Verify web validator, c2pa-conformulator.netlify.app; Wikipedia, Content Authenticity Initiative, B12) is a distinct entity sharing the name's words: a tool that validates manifests, not the program that designates conforming products; it is not a sense of the name. No card is a homonym.
distinct_entities: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (the operator; no Wikipedia article of its own)
Content Authenticity Initiative (Adobe's coalition, publisher of cards 2 and 3; #615 names it as C2PA)
Content Credentials / the C2PA specification (what the program certifies conformance to)
the C2PA Trust List and TSA Trust List (lists the program administers; the census lists the Trust List among the entity's aka)
Creator Assertions Working Group identity assertions (the extension the Explainer points to for identity)
Trufo and SSL.com (certification authorities on the Trust List; Trufo hosts the program document)

captures.description: THE C2PA CONFORMANCE PROGRAM, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a risk-based governance and verification framework run by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity to ensure hardware and software products properly implement the Content Credentials specification.' Components (the Conforming Products List on the Conformance Explorer, generator products at assurance Level 1 or 2, validator products, certificate authorities and the Trust List), the process (expression of interest, agreements, evidence, self-tests) and trust ('only conforming generator products can receive production claim-signing certificates', 'end-to-end tamper evidence'). Eight cards: C2PA's conformance page and FAQ, two Content Authenticity Initiative pages, the Explorer, SSL.com, Trufo (9 October 2026), Scott Perry on LinkedIn (31 July 2026, the v0.2 documents).
